# MR ESTATES

> MR Estates is a premium Melbourne real estate agency specialising in residential sales, rentals, off-the-plan projects, and commercial property. Our approach is curated, organised, and calm — we favour careful selection and considered expertise over volume.

## About

MR Estates helps buyers, sellers, investors, and tenants across metropolitan Melbourne. We guide clients end-to-end: from initial consultation and property shortlisting through inspections, due diligence, negotiation, and settlement, with a single accountable point of contact.

## Services

- Buy: move-in ready luxury apartments and residences for sale across Melbourne.
- Rent: premium residential and commercial tenancies, personally managed.
- Off-the-plan projects: apartment towers and boutique residential developments.
- Commercial property: office, retail, and mixed-use investment opportunities.
- Market insights: research and commentary on the Melbourne property market.

## Areas served

Melbourne, Victoria, Australia — including the CBD and surrounding inner and metropolitan suburbs.
